mapper.select: SELECT id,business_time,business_date,income_name,payer_id,payer_name_snapshot, income_category_id,income_category_name_snapshot,income_amount,funding_channel_id, funding_channel_name_snapshot,note,created_at,updated_at,version FROM ledger_entry WHERE id=#{p.id} AND entry_type='INCOME' AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE ledger_entry SET business_time=#{p.businessTime},business_date=#{p.businessDate},income_name=#{p.incomeName}, payer_id=#{p.payerId},payer_name_snapshot=#{p.payerName},income_category_id=#{p.categoryId}, income_category_name_snapshot=#{p.categoryName},income_amount=#{p.amount},funding_channel_id=#{p.fundingId}, funding_channel_name_snapshot=#{p.fundingName},note=#{p.note},updated_at=#{p.now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{p.id} AND entry_type='INCOME' AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND version=#{p.version}
mapper.select: SELECT income_name FROM ledger_entry WHERE entry_type='INCOME' AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND (#{p.query}='' OR lower(income_name) LIKE ('%' || lower(#{p.query}) || '%') ESCAPE '\') GROUP BY income_name ORDER BY max(updated_at) DESC, income_name LIMIT 20
mapper.update: DELETE FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.id=#{p.id} AND l.entry_type='INCOME' AND l.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency_record i WHERE i.operation='CREATE_INCOME' AND i.idempotency_key=#{p.key} AND i.status='SUCCEEDED' AND i.result_reference=#{p.result}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_entry_template t WHERE t.source_record_id=l.id)
